ruleDefinitions.name: Use Of The SFTP.EXE Binary As A LOLBIN
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "sftp.exe" binary as a LOLBIN by abusing the "-D" flag

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sftp\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-D\\ \\\.\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-D\\ C\\:\\\\.*")))
